# nobus_volume_type (Resource)

Creates a Nobus block-storage volume type. The live v3 API exposes creation only; removing this Terraform resource removes it from state but cannot delete the remote volume type.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `availability_zone` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `extra_specs` (Map of String)
- `is_public` (Boolean)
- `project_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
